app.title: Ecosystem State Forecaster
app.summary: A person picks a data record and a site, then reads a bar chart that shows, for every site, how much each forecasting model improves on a seasonal-average baseline. They step through the held-out months on side-by-side maps of the observed value, the chosen model's forecast and the absolute error, with error numbers for that month. They pick one grid cell and follow it through time against both simple baselines and a prediction band. Finally they set a confidence level and check whether the band's observed coverage matches it.

task.text: Judge whether several forecasting models beat simple persistence and seasonal-average baselines on held-out data, by site and by data record, and whether their uncertainty intervals are calibrated.

data.text: Monthly rasters of a vegetation index for several sites. Alongside them are each model's out-of-sample forecasts, a month-of-year climatology, a precomputed table of interval quantiles, and a headline error per predictor.
data.item: one site's monthly raster on a grid, with each model's forecast for the same month

stage.text: comparing trained models' out-of-sample forecasts against baselines, before reporting

mechanism.text: Sidebar controls choose the record, site, models, map model, month, cell and confidence level, and every view redraws from them. The skill bar chart gives the overview across sites. The map row and the single-cell time series give the detail for one month and one cell, with a red circle marking the chosen cell on every map.

field.text: forecast skill verification against persistence and climatology baselines, for satellite vegetation index in remote sensing

workflow.name: check whether forecasts beat simple baselines on held-out data

steps.step: choose the dataset and the subset to work on
steps.here: A radio button chooses the satellite record. Dropdowns choose the site, which models to show and which model to map.
Grouped bars show each model's skill against the climatology baseline for every site. The mapped model is highlighted, and above zero means the model beats the baseline.

steps.step: step through items one at a time
steps.here: A select slider steps through the test months. For each month the maps show observed, forecast and absolute error, with that month's RMSE, median absolute error and headline skill.
Row and column sliders pick a grid cell. Its series is plotted against persistence, climatology and each chosen model, with the start of the test period marked.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: A confidence slider looks up the conformal half-width and draws the band. The observed coverage over the test period is computed and compared with the nominal level.

distinctive: Skill is always measured against two baselines, persistence and seasonal climatology, rather than reported as accuracy alone.
Switching between a short record and a long record is offered as the main control, because the headline conclusion changes between them.
Prediction intervals are conformal and redraw from a stored quantile table. Observed coverage on later folds is shown against the nominal level.
All forecasts shown are out of sample, from walk-forward folds with spatial hold-out blocks.
